valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2028 (Sep 2027 to Aug 2028) diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD NYSE listing, no ADR conversion. Anchor: FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS $13.97 (+8%), FY2027 guidance $14.39-$14.81 (midpoint $14.60; 24.5-26.5% tax, 15.9-16.1% operating margin, 3-6% local-currency revenue growth, at least $9.5B capital return). FY2028 EPS is my assumption: about +5.5% on the FY2027 midpoint from mid-single-digit revenue growth, flat margin and buybacks of roughly 2%. Q4 FY26 weighted diluted shares 605.3M; about 596M outstanding at Aug 31, 2026.

bear.driver: AI-driven pricing pressure and weaker discretionary consulting hold revenue growth near the 3% low end, margin slips and EPS stalls; the multiple de-rates toward the mid-2026 trough.

base.driver: Revenue grows about 4.5% in local currency with the guided 16.0% operating margin, Managed Services bookings ($12.77B in Q4, book-to-bill 1.2 for the quarter) support growth, and buybacks add about 2% to EPS.

bull.driver: GenAI work converts bookings into 6%+ revenue growth with margin expansion of 30-50bp and larger buybacks; the market re-rates toward its pre-2026 range.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS the $250.49 close implies 16.3x FY2028 EPS (17.2x the FY2027 guidance midpoint of $14.60). The simple mean of the named post-earnings targets (about $239, none with a documented 12-month horizon, so not a weighted target) implies about 15.5x base EPS, or $14.10 of EPS at 17x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $15.40 (about 6.1% of the close); $0.50 of FY2028 EPS moves it by about $8.50 at 17x.
valuation.watch_metric: New bookings and Consulting bookings growth (Q4: $22.2B total, $9.40B Consulting) together with local-currency revenue growth against the 3-6% FY2027 range.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q1 FY2027 results (quarter ending Nov 30, 2026), expected in December 2026; the exact date is not sourced here.

analyst_notes: Since the Oct 1 FY2026 results and FY2027 guidance, named targets moved up sharply from the June to September lows: RBC 175 to 240, Goldman 230 to 260, Susquehanna 210 to 230, Wells Fargo 194 to 210 then 252, while Baird downgraded to Neutral on Oct 21 with a $252 target. Named targets span $200 to $278, a median near $240, mostly below the $261.80 base; the gap to the base is roughly 1 turn of P/E or about $1.30 of FY2028 EPS at 17x. No call documents a 12-month horizon so none enters a weighted target; the list is a subset from an aggregator and unnamed or ambiguous rows were left out.
